_comment: Hand-authored Gladiator sim mechanics. Every Num carries confidence. Keys are validated against built skills at build time. Statuses model timed/conditional effects only; always-on passives (Attack Preparation, Identify Weakness, Impact Hit, Survival Stance...) are NOT statuses because imported gear stats already include them. Sources: aion2.app client dump 2026-09-18 (tokens), Metaroad 2026-10-03, couga54 guide 2026-10-03, Inven Gladiator guide 2026-09-05.

keen-strike.note: chain 1/3 in client; restores 100 MP (Metaroad text); spec 8 +20% MP restored not modelled

wrathful-strike.note: chain 3/3 in client; restores 120 MP (text); spec: Keen Strike rank 16 adds Reckless Strike after it (not modelled)

reckless-strike.note: restores 150 MP (text); reached only through the Keen Strike rank 16 spec

crushing-wave.note: chain 1/2 in client; costs 250 MP; slow animation per guides

blade-toss.note: chain 1/2 in client; Defense -30% and Incoming Heal -50% for 10 s

blade-dance.note: chain 2/2; Metaroad: max 3 chain attacks, cooldown 1 s

overhead-slam.note: client text: damage only to a target afflicted with Knockdown; 7% chance to trigger vs Incapacitated Immunity (bosses). Modelled as castable only while Rage Burst's 10 s window is open (overhead_slam_open). Not modelled: the 7% base chance, Knockdown from Mocking Blade (bosses are immune; the sim cannot tell). Chain to Upward Strike only with the rank-8 option (spec_upward_chain status)

upward-strike.note: chain child of Overhead Slam, castable only with the rank-8 option "Adds [Upward Strike] Chain Skill"; 0.5 s cooldown

ruinous-blow.note: grants Prepare for Battle for 20 s on every cast (client text); costs 250 MP; cooldown 45 s

rage-burst.note: Wounded 10 s + caster PvE Damage Boost +10% for 10 s; text: "Triggers [Overhead Slam] on the target for 10s on hit" = overhead_slam_open status (Overhead Slam needs a Knockdown target; bosses are Incapacitated-immune so only this window or its 7% base chance opens it); costs 100 MP

lunge-stance.note: Combat Speed +20%; spec 20 cooldown-reduction proc not modelled

wave-armor.note: DoT 34% ATK + 207 for the duration; tick data unknown

mocking-blade.note: guaranteed 3 s Knockdown (client text); costs 200 MP

wrath-burst.note: Defiance chain child; Knockdown 3 s; KR/TW-only per aion2hub

forced-fall-11370000.note: needs an Airborne target (Aerial Snare), Knockdown 3 s; KR/TW-only per aion2hub

wrath-wave.note: 50% Knockdown chance (100% vs NPCs per text); the sim treats bosses as NPCs only if the user says so

assault-strike.note: 30% Knockdown chance; Defense up to +20% by targets hit

focused-block.note: every Block/Parry feeds Experienced Counterstrike (party buff) per guides; restores MP and Stamina once on Parry (110 at rank 1, 350 at rank 25) not modelled; this rule assumes the passive is learned

tenaciousness.note: 3 s immunity to damage and status effects, then Damage Tolerance up

defiance.note: CC break + 5 s Tenacity; cooldown falls 60 s to 21 s over ranks

_triggers_note: Murderous Burst (client text): each landed attack gives a Menace stack for 3 s; at 5 stacks it is removed and deals 78% ATK + 539 (rank 1) to up to 4 enemies within 5m and gives Critical Damage Boost for 3 s. One trigger per hit-count group, chance = hits per cast / 5 (a stack per hit instance is an assumption: the text says "landing an attack"). Crit events are not needed; the proc is fired per cast accumulation.
